turns.q: Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
turns.replyTail:
are sorry for this situation.

When an item arrives damaged, we ask that you send us photos of the item in question. Our team will then be able to examine the evidence and offer you a quick solution. For a standard return due to dissatisfaction, the procedure is handled through our dedicated portal.

In order to access your file, could you please provide your order number (it starts with a #) or the email address used during your purchase?

We remain at your entire disposal. 🙂
